name: Cat Distribution System

leader.name: Crazy Cat Lady
leader.construction_rule: Your deck may contain Cat Characters from any Style and up to 10 copies of Stray Cat.
leader.passive: At the start of your Turn, before Ready, if you control 3 or more Cats, put the top card of your deck face down and Ready into your Stash.
leader.note: Lab prototype. Shoebox of Dead Cats is being tested at three copies; Shovel at two copies; Trojan Cat at two copies; Cat Under the Bed at one copy.

mulligan_priority: Shoebox of Dead Cats when the rest of the hand can establish Cats
Shovel when a Shoebox plan is already developing
Hairy Cat when the opposing deck relies on multiple small attackers
Avoid keeping House Panther unless the rest of the hand already establishes the colony
test_watchpoints: Round when Cat Distribution System first triggers
How often the opponent can knock the Cat player below 3 Cats
How often Shoebox reaches three buried Cats
Whether the +1 Power threshold makes Shoebox worthwhile even without drawing Shovel
Whether Shovel's random resurrection is exciting rather than too efficient
How often Shovel hits a cheap Cat versus a high-cost Cat
Whether face-down Cats create meaningful tension about future recovery
Whether Snowball creates meaningful protect-or-risk decisions
Whether Trojan Cat creates interesting attack hesitation without stalling combat
Whether Hairy Cat creates interesting attack sequencing or simply discourages combat
